about: Campus zones. Zones are not defined by any official source; these outlines were drawn over the Sentinel-2 composite and the OpenStreetMap layer to group the campus by function, so they are interpretive (confidence: medium). Coordinates are game-frame metres [x east, z south] from the datum 5.6518 N, 0.1871 W (see docs/LEGON_MASTER_GEOGRAPHY.md). The build clips nothing; it reports which named places fall in each zone and how much of each outline lies outside the campus boundary.

zones.name: Legon Hill and the Convocation Group
zones.rationale: The summit (DEM high point ~150 m) carrying the Great Hall, Registry/central administration and Vice-Chancellor's residence, and Commonwealth Hall on its eastern slope at the head of the avenue.

zones.name: Central academic core
zones.rationale: Departments, faculties and the library on the north side of the avenue around University Square.

zones.name: Main Gate and eastern academic strip
zones.rationale: Between the academic core and the N4: JQB, Institute of African Studies, Law, KAB, Engineering, Performing Arts and Agriculture, entered through the Main Gate.

zones.name: Traditional halls and the Athletic Oval
zones.rationale: South of the avenue across from University Square: Legon, Akuafo and Mensah Sarbah halls with their annexes, Valco, the CC, the SRC building and the sports fields between them.

zones.name: Night Market, Banking Square and the international hostels
zones.rationale: The commercial and social hub south of the traditional halls.

zones.name: Sports precinct
zones.rationale: The stadium, practice pitches, gymnasium, pool and sports directorate by the Okponglo end of the N4.

zones.name: Southern halls and health sciences
anchors: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research
zones.rationale: The newer halls (Limann, Kwapong, Sey, JNA), the School of Public Health, College of Health Sciences and Noguchi.

zones.name: UG Medical Centre and the southern edge
anchors: University of Ghana Medical Center Limited
zones.rationale: The UG Medical Centre and the southern tip of the campus, outside the legacy map's extract.

zones.name: Staff residential (Legon Hill slopes)
zones.rationale: Detached staff houses on curving crescents west and south-west of the halls (Lower Hill Drive, F.K. Apaloo Crescent, Ayido Crescent and others).

zones.name: Northern hostels
zones.rationale: Pentagon, Bani, Evandy and TF/James Topp Nelson Yankah hostels along the west side of the N4, north of the academic core.

zones.name: Botanical Gardens and northern woodland
zones.rationale: The 92 ha Botanical Gardens (with the Vaughan Dam) and the wooded land between them and the academic core.

zones.name: Western woodland, farms and research plots
zones.rationale: Largely undeveloped wooded and scrub land west of Legon Hill, with the aquaculture ponds and agricultural plots in the north-west.

zones.name: East of the N4
zones.rationale: University land east of J.J. Rawlings Avenue (N4): the UGBS Graduate Campus, the University Hospital and Legon police station.
